title: Bright English!
sub: Belajar sambil bermain · Untuk siswa Kelas 5 SD
cando: Menceritakan kebiasaan dengan Simple Present Tense.
Menyebut keluhan sakit dan memberi saran.
Berbelanja dan menyebut harga dalam bahasa Inggris.
Mendeskripsikan hewan dan memberi petunjuk arah.

text.pron_note: Tulisan di dalam garis miring, misalnya apple /é-pel/, adalah cara mengucapkan kata itu. Bacalah seperti membaca tulisan bahasa Indonesia. Huruf é dibaca seperti “e” pada kata “bebek”, sedangkan e biasa dibaca seperti “e” pada kata “emas”. Tanda ini hanya bantuan — cara terbaik tetap mendengarkan guru, orang tua, lagu, atau video berbahasa Inggris. 🎧

goals: Memakai kata keterangan frekuensi: always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

sections.title: Simple Present Tense — Kalimat kebiasaan
head: Subjek
Kata kerja
Contoh
rows: I **don't** drink coffee. He **doesn't** like fish.
sections.after: Aturan -es: kata kerja berakhiran -sh, -ch, -o, -s, -x → washes, watches, goes, does, fixes. Berakhiran konsonan + y → -ies: study → studies. Khusus: have → has.

sections.html:
Letak kata keterangan frekuensi: sebelum kata kerja biasa, tapi sesudah am/is/are.
  • I always brush my teeth. — She never eats spicy food.
  • He is always on time. — They are sometimes late.
sections.title: Ingat, ya!
Rina's Day 🌞
paras: Rina is a fifth-grade student. She always wakes up at 4.30 a.m. She prays and then helps her mother in the kitchen.
She usually goes to school on foot because her school is near her house. School starts at seven o'clock. Rina studies Mathematics, Science, and English. English is her favorite subject!
After school, she often plays with her friends in the park. In the evening, she does her homework and reads a book. She never watches TV until late. She goes to bed at 9 p.m.

sections.instr: Jawab pertanyaan tentang bacaan “Rina's Day”!
items: What time does Rina wake up?|at 4.30 a.m.|at 7 a.m.|at 9 p.m.
How does she go to school?|by bus|on foot|by bicycle
What does she do in the evening?|She watches TV.|She does her homework.|She plays in the park.

sections.instr: Lengkapi dengan bentuk kata kerja yang benar!
sections.ans: 1. reads · 2. go · 3. watches · 4. studies · 5. sleeps · 6. doesn't like
items: My father (read) ___ the newspaper every morning.
We (go) ___ to the mosque on Friday.

sections.instr: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar!
sections.ans: 1. I always eat breakfast. · 2. She is never late. · 3. Does he play football?

sections.instr: How often do you…? Isi tabel dengan always / usually / sometimes / never, lalu buat kalimat!
sections.ans: Jawaban bebas. Contoh: I always brush my teeth before bed.
head: Activity
How often?

goals: Mendeskripsikan penampilan: tinggi badan, rambut, mata.

sections.title: What does she look like?
head: Question
Answer
Arti
rows: She **is** tall and slim. She **has** long straight hair.
sections.after: Pakai is + sifat/ukuran badan (She is tall), dan has + bagian tubuh (She has curly hair). Urutan kata sifat: ukuran + bentuk + warna + benda → long straight black hair.

sections.title: My Best Friend 👭
paras: My best friend is **Aisyah**. She is eleven years old. We are in the same class.
Aisyah is tall and slim. She has short curly hair and round black eyes. She wears glasses. She has a sweet smile. 😊
Aisyah is very smart and diligent. She is also kind and helpful. She often helps me with Mathematics. She is never angry.
Her hobby is drawing. She can draw beautiful pictures of flowers. I am happy to have a friend like her!

sections.instr: True atau False berdasarkan bacaan?
Lingkari kata yang benar!
Pasangkan sifat dengan artinya!
Deskripsikan sahabatmu! (minimal 5 kalimat)

sections.title: What's wrong? — Ada apa?
head: Question / Problem
Advice — Saran
rows: You **should** drink a lot of water and take medicine.
You **shouldn't** drink ice. You should drink warm water.
sections.after: should = sebaiknya · shouldn't (should not) = sebaiknya tidak. Setelah should, pakai kata kerja bentuk dasar: You should go, bukan goes.

sections.title: At the school health room (UKS) 🏥
lines: I feel dizzy and I have a headache.
Saya merasa pusing dan sakit kepala.
Did you eat breakfast this morning?
You should eat some bread and drink this tea. Then lie down for a while.
Sebaiknya kamu makan roti dan minum teh ini. Lalu berbaring sebentar.
Thank you. I feel better now.
Terima kasih. Saya merasa lebih baik sekarang.

sections.instr: Pasangkan keluhan dengan saran yang tepat!
left: I have a cut on my finger.
right: You should see a doctor and take medicine.
You should put a bandage on it.

sections.instr: Lengkapi dengan should atau shouldn't!
items: You ___ wash your hands before eating.
Children ___ sleep eight to ten hours a day.

sections.instr: Buat poster “Stay Healthy!” berisi 3 kebiasaan sehat. 🎨

sections.html: Mencuci tangan dengan sabun minimal 20 seconds bisa membunuh banyak kuman. Caranya? Nyanyikan lagu “Happy Birthday” dua kali sambil mencuci tangan! 🧼🎶

goals: Menyebut bilangan puluhan, ratusan, dan ribuan.

sections.title: Big numbers — Bilangan besar
items: tujuh puluh · delapan puluh · sembilan puluh
sections.label: learn

sections.html:
• Dalam bahasa Inggris, hundred dan thousand tidak diberi -s jika ada angka di depannya: two hundred, ten thousand.
  • Orang Inggris menulis ribuan dengan koma: 10,000; orang Indonesia dengan titik: 10.000.
  • Rp10.000 dibaca ten thousand rupiah.
sections.title: Ingat, ya!

head: Seller (penjual)
Buyer (pembeli)
rows: Yes, please. I'm looking for a school bag.
It's one hundred fifty thousand rupiah.
That's expensive. Do you have a cheaper one?
OK. **I'll take it.** Here is the money.
Here is your change. Thank you!

sections.title: Toko Kiko — Price list (Daftar harga)

sections.instr: Tulis harga di Toko Kiko dengan kata-kata!
sections.ans: 1. three thousand · 2. five thousand five hundred · 3. one hundred fifty thousand · 4. two hundred seventy-five thousand

sections.instr: Hitung! Kamu punya Rp100.000. Jawab dalam bahasa Inggris.
sections.ans: 1. one hundred thirty thousand (Rp130.000 – uangnya tidak cukup!) · 2. fifteen thousand · 3. fourteen thousand
items: A football and a storybook cost ___ rupiah.

sections.instr: Role play! Praktikkan percakapan jual-beli dengan temanmu memakai daftar harga Toko Kiko. Lengkapi dulu naskahnya:
sections.ans: Jawaban bebas sesuai barang; kata terakhir: change.
sections.html:
🧑‍💼 Seller: Good morning! Can I help you?
🧒 Buyer: Yes, please. I want to buy ___ .
🧑‍💼 Seller: Here you are.
🧒 Buyer: How much is it?
🧑‍💼 Seller: It is ___ rupiah.
🧒 Buyer: OK, I will take it. Here is the money.
🧑‍💼 Seller: Thank you. Here is your ___ .
Uang kertas rupiah terbesar adalah one hundred thousand rupiah (Rp100.000). Bergambar Ir. Soekarno dan Drs. Mohammad Hatta. 💵

goals: Mengelompokkan hewan: pemakan tumbuhan, pemakan daging, habitatnya.
Mendeskripsikan hewan dengan It has … / It can … / It eats …

sections.title: Animal body parts — Bagian tubuh hewan
sections.label: learn

sections.title: The Komodo Dragon 🦎
paras: The Komodo dragon is the biggest lizard in the world. It lives only in Indonesia, on Komodo Island and a few islands near it in East Nusa Tenggara.
A Komodo dragon can grow up to three meters long. It has a long tail, strong legs, and sharp claws. Its skin is covered with hard scales.
Komodo dragons are carnivores. They eat deer, pigs, and buffaloes. They can run fast and swim well. They have a very good sense of smell. They use their long yellow tongue to smell!
Komodo dragons are protected animals. We must take care of them. 💚

sections.instr: Jawab berdasarkan bacaan!
items: Where does the Komodo dragon live?|in Africa|in Indonesia|in Australia
How long can it grow?|up to 3 meters|up to 30 meters|up to 1 meter
What does it eat?|grass and leaves|deer and pigs|fruit
What does it use to smell?|its nose only|its tail|its tongue

goals: Memakai turn left, turn right, go straight, next to, opposite, between.

sections.title: Directions — Petunjuk arah
items: at the end of the street
et di end of de striit
sections.label: learn

sections.title: Asking the way — Bertanya arah
head: English
Arti
rows: **How can I get to** the bank?
**Go straight** and **turn left** at the crossroads.
Jalan lurus lalu belok kiri di perempatan.
The library is **next to** the mosque. It's **opposite** the park.
Perpustakaan di sebelah masjid, di seberang taman.
**Is it far?** — No, it's near. It's about five minutes on foot.
Apakah jauh? — Tidak, dekat. Sekitar lima menit jalan kaki.

sections.label: play
sections.title: Town map — Peta kota
Where is the post office?
lines: Excuse me. How can I get to the post office?
Permisi. Bagaimana caranya ke kantor pos?
Go straight to the crossroads, then turn right. Walk past the park. The post office is on your right, next to the park.
Jalan lurus ke perempatan, lalu belok kanan. Lewati taman. Kantor pos ada di sebelah kananmu, di samping taman.
No, it isn't. It's only three minutes on foot.
Tidak. Hanya tiga menit jalan kaki.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!

sections.instr: Lihat peta. Kamu berada di YOU ARE HERE dan menghadap ke atas (utara). Pilih jawaban yang benar!
items: The restaurant is ___ the pharmacy.|next to|behind|opposite
The school is ___ the restaurant (di seberang jalan).|next to|opposite|between
Go straight across the crossroads. On your right, you can see the …|hospital|library|bank
Walk straight from YOU ARE HERE. On your left, you pass the restaurant and the …|park|bakery|school

sections.instr: Lihat peta, lalu lengkapi petunjuk arah!
sections.ans: 1. straight · 2. left · 3. right · 4. next to · 5. opposite
items: To the library: Go ___ across the crossroads. The library is on your right.
To the bank: Go straight to the crossroads and turn ___ . Walk past the hospital. The bank is on your right.
To the post office: Go straight and turn ___ at the crossroads. Walk past the park. The post office is on your right.
The bakery is ___ the park. (di seberang jalan)

sections.instr: Tulis petunjuk arah dari sekolahmu ke rumahmu (atau ke tempat favoritmu)!

items: My sister ___ to school by bus every day.|go|goes|going
I ___ eat vegetables. They are healthy. (100%)|never|always|sometimes
I have a toothache. — You should see a …|dentist|farmer|pilot
Rp25.000 = …|twenty-five hundred rupiah|twenty-five thousand rupiah|two hundred fifty rupiah
You ___ eat too much candy. It's bad for your teeth.
How ___ is this bag? — It's fifty thousand rupiah.
Go straight and ___ right at the crossroads.
